function.name: addToWaitlist
function.description: Saves the caller as a lead for the team to call back. Use it whenever you can't book a specific time (they want a callback, a quote, or the owner needs to scope the job). Call it once you have the caller's name, phone number, and what they need.

patient_name.description: Caller's full name as they stated it

phone.description: Caller's callback phone number including area code

preferred_days.description: Days that work for them, e.g. 'Monday, Wednesday' or 'any day'

preferred_times.description: Time of day that works for them, e.g. 'mornings', 'after 3pm', 'any time'

service_needed.description: What they need, in plain words, e.g. 'AC not cooling', 'roof leak repair', 'kitchen remodel estimate', 'teeth cleaning'

priority.description: 'urgent' for anything your instructions treat as urgent or an emergency (no heat/AC in extreme weather, active leak, safety hazard, severe pain). Otherwise 'routine'.

notes.description: Anything else useful: service address, how they heard about the business, details of the problem
